source_name: OTP Bank Nyrt. – Befektetőknek (IR hub, HU)
why_relevant: Root of the densest disclosure estate in Hungarian banking: routes to annual reports, quarterly flash reports (gyorsjelentés), interim management reports, financial calendar, announcements and analyst material for OTP Group and its country segments.

source_name: OTP Bank – Pénzügyi naptár / Befektetői Kapcsolatok Naptár (financial calendar)
why_relevant: Gives forward-looking publication dates for earnings, AGM and reports — the scheduling backbone for any recurring collection routine against OTP.

source_name: OTP Group – Investor Relations (English IR estate, otpgroup.info)
why_relevant: English-language mirror/extension of OTP's IR: IFRS reports, integrated annual reports, conference-call presentations, reporting schedule. Usually the easiest machine-readable path for cross-country comparison and for the country-segment detail on Hungary.

source_name: OTP Bank – IR közlemények (regulated announcements archive by year)
why_relevant: Year-indexed archive of regulated/extraordinary announcements (acquisitions, bond closings, capital actions) — the fastest early signal of strategic moves before they reach reports.

source_name: OTP Bank – Hírek / sajtóközlemények (corporate news & press releases)
why_relevant: Non-regulated commercial and product communication (pricing, digital services, card/POS initiatives) that regulated filings do not carry; important for payments-side intelligence.

source_name: OTP Jelzálogbank Zrt. – Pénzügyi információk (covered-bond issuer disclosures)
why_relevant: Separate Hungarian-domiciled bond-issuing entity inside OTP Group; mortgage-bond (jelzáloglevél) programme and transparency reporting expose funding structure and mortgage-book quality not visible at group level.

source_name: MBH Bank Nyrt. – Befektetőknek / közzétételek (HU investor estate)
why_relevant: Post-merger MBH (MKB+Takarék+Budapest Bank) is Hungary's #2 bank; as a bond issuer it publishes near-issuer-grade financial statements, extraordinary announcements and prospectuses. Legacy paths still carry 'mkb-bankrol' segments, which matters for crawler design.

source_name: MBH Bank – Investor Relations (English, mbhbank.com)
why_relevant: Separate English IR domain carrying investor reports, announcements and an 'International issues' section for the EUR EMTN programme, base prospectus, supplements and senior-preferred investor presentations — the richest strategy-level MBH material.

source_name: MBH Bank – Alaptájékoztató / kibocsátási program (HUF 500bn base prospectus)
why_relevant: Base prospectuses are the single richest structured description of a Hungarian bank: business model, risk factors, group structure, funding, litigation, and segment financials — all in one MNB-approved document, refreshed annually.

source_name: MBH Jelzálogbank Nyrt. – Befektetőknek (mortgage bond issuer)
why_relevant: Listed/bond-issuing group entity publishing its own base prospectus (HUF 150bn 2025-26 programme incl. green mortgage bonds), semi-annual gyorsjelentés and quarterly CRR Art.129 transparency reports — granular mortgage-market and green-funding intelligence.

source_name: GRÁNIT Bank Nyrt. – Befektetőknek (IR estate of the newest BÉT-listed bank)
why_relevant: Listed on BÉT since Nov 2024; fastest-growing digital-first Hungarian bank. IR tree confirmed to contain Közzétételek, Jelentések, Események (incl. report publication dates), Kibocsátási tájékoztató, Társaságirányítás — a compact but complete disclosure set on a challenger-model bank.

source_name: GRÁNIT Bank – blog / aktuális (corporate narrative & strategy commentary)
why_relevant: Management-voiced posts (e.g. the IPO/'dimenzióváltás' piece) explain strategy and capital actions in plainer terms than the filings; useful for intent signals on digital banking and payments.

source_name: Budapesti Értéktőzsde (BÉT/BSE) – Kibocsátói közzétételek / KIBINFO news database
why_relevant: Statutory publication venue for every BÉT-listed issuer (OTP, Gránit, MBH group entities, OPUS, 4iG). Single funnel that catches filings even when an issuer's own site lags; document PDFs are served from stable /newkibdata/{id}/ paths, making it the most automatable single node in this cell.

source_name: MNB Közzétételek (kozzetetelek.mnb.hu) – officially appointed storage mechanism (OAM)
why_relevant: Statutory OAM for all Hungarian regulated information: every listed/bond-issuing bank must file regular and extraordinary disclosures and inside information here. Legally complete backstop for the whole cell, and the authoritative record when an issuer site is restructured.

source_name: OPUS GLOBAL Nyrt. – konszolidált éves jelentés (BÉT-listed holding with financial arms)
why_relevant: Large BÉT-listed holding (top-5 capitalisation) whose consolidated annual reports document its financial-sector participations, ratings (Scope BB/stable) and funding — the practical entry point to the Opus/4iG-adjacent financial arms named in this cell.

source_name: 4iG Nyrt. – befektetői/vállalatirányítási dokumentumok
why_relevant: BÉT-listed tech/telco group with adjacent financial and payments-relevant interests; its prospectuses and responsible-governance reports name the IR function and disclose group structure. Included as the 4iG-adjacent leg of the cell, at lower yield than the banks.

source_name: Erste Jelzálogbank Zrt. – Befektetői információk
why_relevant: Hungarian-domiciled bond-issuing bank (mortgage bonds incl. a green programme) inside a foreign-parent group; publishes its own year-indexed disclosures and prospectuses, giving Hungary-only figures that the Austrian parent's reporting blends away.

source_name: UniCredit Jelzálogbank Zrt. – alaptájékoztatók és éves/gyorsjelentések
why_relevant: Another Hungarian-domiciled bond-issuing bank with a dedicated page set for base prospectuses and annual/semi-annual reports, including xHTML/ESEF-format business reports — a clean, machine-friendly Hungary-only data point.

source_name: Quartr – OTP Bank earnings calls, transcripts and IR material
why_relevant: Aggregates OTP earnings-call audio and transcripts — the Q&A is where management says things that never enter the written filings (competitive posture, payments/digital investment, acquisition intent).

source_name: MarketScreener / financial-news mirrors of MBH and OTP flash reports
why_relevant: Useful as a low-latency English alerting layer and for spotting that a filing exists; not authoritative and licence-restricted, so use it as a trigger to fetch the primary document from the issuer or BÉT/MNB.

source_name: K&H Bank Zrt. – Nyilvánosságra hozandó információk (statutory disclosure hub)
why_relevant: Central Hitpt.122.§ / CRR Pillar 3 disclosure page of the KBC-owned Hungarian subsidiary; carries entity-level annual accounts, MNB decisions and asset-profitability indicators. K&H has no listed equity in HU so this is the only first-party entity-level financial estate.

source_name: K&H Jelzálogbank Zrt. – éves, féléves és auditori jelentések
why_relevant: Separate licensed mortgage-bank entity inside the K&H group with its own statutory reports; gives a second entity-level P&L slice and mortgage-funding view not visible in the bank's own accounts.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary Zrt. – Éves jelentések (vállalatirányítás)
why_relevant: Entity-level annual reports of the Hungarian Erste subsidiary, on a deep, non-obvious corporate-governance path that generic searching misses.

source_name: Erste Bank Hungary Zrt. – Hivatalos közzétételek (CRR Pillar 3 disclosure statements)
why_relevant: Dated stream of CRR Article 431-451a disclosure statements (annual + semi-annual key metrics and ESG per Art. 447/449a). Note the path contains the misspelling 'hivatalalos-kozzetetelek', which is exactly why crawlers miss it.

source_name: BÉT / KIB newkibdata – Erste Bank Hungary Pillar 3 (Kockázati Jelentés) PDFs
why_relevant: Erste Bank Hungary is a bond issuer on BÉT, so its Pillar 3 / risk reports are also filed into the exchange's issuer-disclosure store (newkibdata). This is a second, more machine-friendly copy of documents that are awkward to reach on the bank site.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. – Éves, féléves jelentések (Pénzügyi adatok)
why_relevant: Entity-level annual and semi-annual reports of the RBI Hungarian subsidiary, filed under the press-room rather than an IR section — a classic non-obvious placement for an unlisted subsidiary.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. – Kockázatkezelési információk / nyilvánosságra hozatal PDFs
why_relevant: Semi-annual CRR Pillar 3 disclosure PDFs ('nyilvanossagra_hozatal_RBHU_YYYYHx / QX'), auditor-verified; the filename pattern is highly predictable and makes systematic collection cheap.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Zrt. – Tőkepiaci törvény szerinti jelentések
why_relevant: Capital-Markets-Act (Tpt.) reports the bank must publish as a bond/securities issuer — a distinct disclosure obligation from the accounting one, and often the timeliest entity-level numbers.
